|game_text=Deploy on table (only at start of game) with up to three systems from outside your deck face-down under here. |errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1, the current text (version 2 of 2). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB1-126E-Hidden_Fortress-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 10 November 2026); the release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text (see [[Hidden Fortress]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Hidden Fortress]]): Virtual Block 1 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 126E)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table (only at start of game) with up to three systems from outside your deck face-down under here. If non-[Virtual Block 4] Hidden Base on table: once per game, may deploy a system from here and/or exchange Hidden Base indicator with a system (from parsec 1 to 8) under here. [Immune to Alter]” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-126E-Hidden_Fortress.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-L-hiddenfortress-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (Light Side p. 24)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> reprints it character for character: a stale reprint, not a new version, and it does not make this text current again.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC website card list, Virtual Block 1 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1210_123">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock1Type (Virtual Block 1 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205209/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' “once per game” is written “Once per game”, with a capital O. The same wording is already in the Players Committee's Holotable card data of 29 May 2010<ref name="cdf-1210_123">[https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/lightside.cdf Holotable card data file, version 29 May 2010] (Players Committee data, copy on GitHub).
